title: PU-12M lesson 1: the driver-electrician
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/pu12m.json: headset_on_driver, deploy_power) and the crew data's reports (data/crew/pu12m_crew.json), with their sources
notes: The battery commander's orders are given by the lesson (on_start) at the learner's pace. The lesson's scenario starts with the headset off.

steps.title: The driver-electrician's seat
lines: You are the driver-electrician (No. 4) of the PU-12M, the battery's command post: front left, at the wheel.
You drive the post, and you give it its power: the AB-1 petrol generator set it carries, set out on the ground at the halt. Nothing in the post works until you have done your part.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The ŠČV input board
lines: On the wall at your left: the ŠČV input board. Its supply switch takes the post's 220 V from the AB-1 set (АГРЕГАТ), from the G-290B generator on the move, or from a mains supply (СЕТЬ). Below it, the AB-1 set's own switches.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The PVS-3 intercom box
lines: Beside it, the PVS-3: your box. On ВС, the intercom, you hear the commander's orders and your reports go to the crew; its selector can also put your headset on one of the post's sets (РСТ-1 to РСТ-4), and its button calls the commander's RTK-1.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: Your headset (шлемофон)
lines: Put your шлемофон on and plug its cord into the PVS-3. Leave the box on ВС.
Without it you hear only voices in the cabin, and over the engine little of those: the commander's orders come on the intercom.
steps.why: The squad leader reports the post's communications ready only when every man's headset is on.
steps.hint: J: put it on (or point the cross at it, left click).

steps.title: Your panel
lines: Ahead of you, the driver's panel: the engine's gauges.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The commander: «Пункт управления развернуть!»
lines: The battery commander orders the post deployed (you hear it on the intercom). Each of the crew has his part; yours is the power, and the others wait for it: the radios, the mast's lights, the ASPD-U, all run on the AB-1's 220 V.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The AB-1 out: on the ground and cabled
lines: Set the AB-1 set out: clicking its switch takes you out through your hatch and down to the ground behind the post, where you lift it down, earth it and run its cable to the post.
steps.why: The set runs on the ground away from the post: its noise and heat stay outside, and an earthed set can't shock the crew.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Start the set: ПУСК
lines: Once it is out and cabled, start it: ПУСК, on the set itself.
steps.why: The petrol engine runs up to speed before it gives a steady 50 Hz.
steps.hint: At the set: look at it, left click (the mouse wheel picks which of its jobs).

steps.title: On line: the supply switch to АГРЕГАТ
lines: When the set runs, go back in (F by the front wheel climbs up, F at your hatch climbs in) and turn the ŠČV's supply switch to АГРЕГАТ: the post takes its power from the set.
steps.why: Until this switch, the set runs for nobody.
steps.hint: Inside: point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Report it: «Агрегат работает, питание подано!»
lines: Tell the crew: O, then «Агрегат работает, питание подано!» (Generator running, power on!). The radio operator switches the equipment on when he hears it.
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: The crew deploys
lines: Your part is done. Now the others: the radio operator raises the mast and powers the equipment, the squad leader orients the post, the commander turns on the ASPD-U and his radios. Listen to their reports.

steps.title: The driver-electrician's part: done
lines: That is your part of deploying the post: your headset on, the AB-1 set out, started, and on line, and the power reported.
Esc, then M: the missions menu, and the next seat's lesson.
